A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 21-page versions of ActionPiece. Text and rendered-page inspection, including Appendices A–H, support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original ActionPiece recommendation experiments, ablations and tokenization analyses in Tables 4–5 and Figures 4–6.

after.justification: v3 retains the original ActionPiece experiments, ablations and analyses reported in v2.

M1.justification: Weighted token-pair merging, intermediate nodes, set permutation regularization, model training and inference remain unchanged, including Algorithms 1–4 and the appendix implementation.

E1.justification: Both evaluate next-item recommendation on Amazon Reviews Sports, Beauty and CDs. The Sports count revision does not establish different dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: Tables 4–5 retain the same baselines and comparison variants. The newly cited Tay et al. (2022) work is not added as an evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: Table 3 revises Sports from 18,357 users and 35,598 items to 35,598 users and 18,357 items. This changes the reported dataset dimensions; the PDFs do not establish resampling or rerun experiments. Splits, preprocessing, metrics and training settings are unchanged.

E4.justification: The Table 5 ablations, vocabulary-size, token-utilization and inference-ensemble analyses in Figures 4–6, and Section 4.5 case study are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both report five random seeds, identify seeds 2024–2028 in Appendix H, and use identical uncertainty reporting in Table 4.

E6.justification: Table 3 exchanges the Sports user and item counts between their columns. All recommendation scores, ablation values, plotted results and qualitative findings remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation, co-occurrence probabilities in Equations (1)–(2), and vocabulary-construction complexity derivation in Appendix C.2 are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about context-aware action tokenization, weighted vocabulary construction and set permutation regularization.

C2.justification: Interpretations of SPR benefits, vocabulary and inference tradeoffs, feature-crossing connections, and future applications are unchanged, including Appendix E.

D1.justification: Implementation details, preprocessing instructions, hyperparameters, hardware and code access information are unchanged. The Sports count revision is not accompanied by revised reproduction instructions.

R1.justification: v3 adds Tay et al. (2022), Transformer memory as a differentiable search index, to the opening introduction citation and bibliography. This modestly expands attribution without changing the novelty positioning.

P1.justification: Editorial changes are limited to the introductory citation and bibliography addition and the arXiv version/date update. Explanatory prose, terminology and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Spacing below Figure 3 and text flow across pages 5–6 change slightly. The added reference reflows bibliography pages 12–13. Figure content and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: v3 addresses an apparent transposition of Sports user and item counts in Table 3 and adds attribution to Tay et al. (2022). These provide limited improvements to dataset reporting and scholarly context; the method, empirical evidence and appendices are otherwise unchanged.
